explication: Open CAD Studio is a shared-core 2D drafting and 3D modeling application for desktop and web. Users open or create a drawing, issue interactive drafting/modeling commands, inspect the result in rendered viewports, and save or export it. The README also documents automation, plugins, and format-specific workflows. The graph combines those documented capabilities with visible module references; many domain links are documented at product level because their implementation excerpts were not sampled.
